comment: The hash of the Manhattan preset's map SVG, as test/layout.test.ts renders it: a whole city with a borough in use and one packed up. The city builder's steps (docs/city-builder.md) must keep it until the drawing is meant to change. Step two set it: the station and the towers became two buildings, so the MetLife slab paints before the terminal (a pixel strip on its east wall, checked in the browser). The street lights along the avenues were spaced twice as far apart (one a cell, not two) on 2026-11-05, at the person's request: the only change to the map.
